subject: general
question: What is the name of the supercomputer designed and installed by Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (CDAC) at IIT Roorkee, under Phase II of National Supercomputing Mission (NSM) in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PARAM Ganga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The supercomputer **PARAM Ganga** was designed and installed by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (CDAC).
 
• It was installed at **IIT Roorkee** as part of Phase II of the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM) in March 2022.
 
• The installation of PARAM Ganga is aimed at boosting research and innovation in various scientific fields.
 
• The National Supercomputing Mission (NSM) is an initiative by the Indian government to enhance the computing capabilities in academic and research institutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (CDAC)**

 
 
• CDAC is an organization established in 1988 by the Indian government to carry out research and development in IT, Electronics, and associated areas.
 
• It is known for its high-performance computing and grid computing capabilities.
 
• CDAC has played a significant role in the development of the PARAM series of supercomputers.
 
 
 
• **National Supercomputing Mission (NSM)**
 
 
• Launched in 2015, NSM is a joint initiative of the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
 
• The mission aims to enhance the research capacities and capabilities of the country by setting up a network of supercomputers.
 
• It involves the installation of more than 70 high-performance computing facilities across India.
 
• The mission also focuses on the development of indigenous supercomputing capabilities and applications.
 
 
 
• **Supercomputing Applications**
 
 
• Supercomputers are used for complex simulations, scientific research, weather forecasting, drug discovery, and various other fields that require high computational power.
 
• They play a crucial role in solving large-scale problems in physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering.
 
 

The correct answer is **Option 2**__.
